notes.en: [[character:burnice]] was made as an off-field Anomaly applier, but she has surprisingly strong build-up when played on-field. Her EX Double Shot and hold Basic Attack are especially strong, and the hold Basic even counts for extra Afterburn triggers. Balancing Disorders can be hard.
Target stats at level 60: ATK 2,500 to 3,200+ (depends on your W-Engine and Disc main stats), HP 9,500 to 10,000+, DEF 800+, Anomaly Proficiency 350 to 400+ and Anomaly Mastery 153+.

[[character:velina]] and [[character:remielle]] are her best partners for Wind Anomaly (Vortex) teams. [[character:yuzuha]] and [[character:nangong-yu]] are a decent shell: Yuzuha makes up the Anomaly build-up gap and Nangong is effectively an Anomaly agent disguised as a Stunner.
The W-Engine ranking was calculated with [[character:alice]] (Practiced Perfection) and [[character:yuzuha]] (Metanukimorphosis) as teammates. Percentages are relative to her signature.
